entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your careful study of mental magic grants you mastery in your discipline.

Prerequisite(s): Psychic discipline class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus on caster level checks and concentration checks when casting spells from your psychic discipline, and you gain a +1 insight bonus on saving throws against spells from your discipline.
